description: Past clients due (or coming up) to re-book. A client's re-book date is the account's re-book timing (lead_value lead_unit, default 30 days) BEFORE the anniversary of the date they made their last booking — events book months ahead, so that's when next year gets planned. Returns 'due' (re-book date within two weeks either side of today) and 'upcoming' (next 60 days), each client with last gig date, booked_on, value, anniversary, rebook_date, days_until_rebook and the nudge status (sent / dismissed / converted), plus the timing in force. Change the timing with update_automation type=rebook_email. Use nudge_rebooking to reach out.
name: list_rebooking
title: List Rebooking
